name: rain
title: Rain
description: The weather over a whole world, drawn only around the camera: rain streaks and splashes, snowflakes, and rings on every `WetStreet`'s puddles, as hard as a `weather` function says (`weatherAt` gives the weather as a pure function of a clock). It stays out from under roofs through a depth map of the still world drawn from above in its first seconds. WebGLRenderer only.
